The '''Merilang-1221''' was a full-spectrum numerical analyzer that was created to process inbound transmissions for numerical encryption.<ref name="CSWE" /> During the [[Caamas Document Crisis|crisis]] caused by the discovery of the [[Caamas Document]]<ref name="VotF" /> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> which implicated members of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Crypt Chief]] [[Zakarisz Ghent]] volunteered to accompany [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hestiv]] to the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] [[Ubiqtorate base|station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the planet [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] to attempt to recover an original copy of the document. Ghent was provided with a room and equipment to aid him in his work, including a Merilang-1221.<ref name="VotF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Merilang-1221 was first mentioned in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Vision of the Future]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="VotF" />
